item.title: Coordinating Agents With Mechanism Design
item.description: Imagine the large scale deployment of AI agents that make decisions on behalf of individuals or firms. For example, in online advertising auctions, an advertiser gives their high-level goal and constraints to a personal bidding agent. The responsibility of the bidding agent is to convert the advertiser’s goal and constraints into per-auction bids without human review. How do we ensure: (1) the advertiser’s goal is maximized, and (2) the outcome (who wins the auction) is efficient?

item.title: Mechanism Design - A Primer
item.description:
This post is an ongoing investigation of my alternative view of AI and the role of algorithms for multi-agent systems in markets.
